key_insight: The paper replaces continual training with continual inference: a frozen PFN updates beliefs over latent concepts from added exemplars, reducing forgetting without gradient updates.
engineering_relevance: This offers a practical continual learning design for deployed systems that must adapt to new classes or domains while keeping a stable model and interpretable concept structure.
method: Meta-train a PFN on concept-annotated data, then freeze all parameters.
Perform in-context Bayesian inference over a latent concept space using an expanding evidence memory.
Support both class-incremental and domain-incremental settings without needing task identity, while handling noisy or incomplete concept labels.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports experiments on class- and domain-incremental learning datasets showing competitive performance and interpretable latent concepts.
watch_item: Performance depends on the quality and coverage of the exemplar memory and on concept annotations used during meta-training, which may limit scalability or transfer if the concept set is weak.
